new_value: Implemented recent_local_evidence() check in Rust HybridRouter (hybrid.rs). Added LOCAL_EVIDENCE_LIFETIME_MS (1200s) constant, local_evidence cache to track when authenticated evidence was last seen for each destination, and recent_local_evidence() function. Updated route_mesh_local() to drop 0200::/8 Yggdrasil addresses without recent evidence (spec 10.2). Evidence is recorded when processing announces, learning from data packets, and receiving RREPs. Added 14 new tests covering evidence tracking and evidence-gated routing.
